Extended Reduced-Dose Apixaban for Cancer-Associated Venous Thromboembolism. DOI: 10.1056/NEJMoa2416112.
Source systematic review for malhotra-2025: Reduced versus standard dose apixaban for secondary prevention of cancer-associated venous thromboembolism: A systematic review and meta-analysis.

facts.statement_en: Systematic review and pairwise meta-analysis of intervention studies.
Adults with active cancer after at least six months of anticoagulation for venous thromboembolism; reduced-dose versus full-dose apixaban; efficacy and safety.
Eligibility is specified in the accepted protocol; final-review methods are identified separately.

status: REPORTED; method_domain: ELIGIBILITY; method_basis: PRESPECIFIED_PROTOCOL; description: Include randomized controlled trials comparing apixaban 2.5 mg twice daily with apixaban 5 mg twice daily for extended treatment after at least six months of anticoagulation in adults with active cancer and venous thromboembolism. Extract directly reported participant counts and outcome-specific denominators through 12 months.

status: REPORTED; method_domain: SELECTION_PROCESS; method_basis: FINAL_REVIEW_METHOD; description: Two investigators independently screened studies using blinded Rayyan review; discrepancies were resolved by consensus with a third investigator.

status: REPORTED; method_domain: DATA_COLLECTION; method_basis: PRESPECIFIED_PROTOCOL; description: Two reviewers will independently extract trial identifiers, publication year, study design, sample size, participant demographics, cancer type, VTE subtype, follow-up duration, dosing strategy, baseline characteristics, and all eligible efficacy and safety outcomes using a standardized form. Disagreements will be resolved by a third reviewer.
status: REPORTED; method_domain: RISK_OF_BIAS; method_basis: PRESPECIFIED_PROTOCOL; description: Risk of bias will be assessed using Cochrane RoB 2.
status: REPORTED; method_domain: EFFECT_MEASURE; method_basis: PRESPECIFIED_PROTOCOL; description: The review used risk ratio, hazard ratio.

status: REPORTED; method_domain: SYNTHESIS_MODEL; method_basis: PRESPECIFIED_PROTOCOL; description: Random-effects meta-analysis will be performed in Review Manager 5.5. Risk ratios with 95% confidence intervals will be pooled using the Mantel-Haenszel method. Between-study variance will be estimated using the DerSimonian-Laird method.
status: REPORTED; method_domain: HETEROGENEITY; method_basis: PRESPECIFIED_PROTOCOL; description: Heterogeneity will be assessed using Cochran's Q, I², and τ².
